Noticed UBL-SIGN-001's cluster (175ADB055BC12E8F, 452B9C973F40966B, 26CD31E7F8CF91E1) and re-read 175ADB055BC12E8F's own rule_text: 'verification and signing remain a separate pluggable opt-in', phrasing near-identical to UBL-EXT-001's already-closed 'expose registered typed adapters as opt-in' (event 252's ExtensionAdapterRegistry).

3. Recognized this as a third instance of the same successful pattern (CodeListRegistry -> ExtensionAdapterRegistry -> SignatureBackendRegistry): a pluggable, caller-populated registry that this package never bundles a real backend implementation for, since real XMLDSig signing/verification needs cryptography, key material, and trust anchors entirely out of scope for a format library, with no SAL fact documenting a specific profile precisely enough to build one without fabricating spec content.

4. Read model/document.py's existing signature_preserved/with_root and validator.py's ubl.signature.invalidated diagnostic directly to confirm the 'report before saving, never rewrite' half is already fully proven and would not be duplicated.

5. Designed SignatureBackendRegistry (model/signature_backend.py): a single-slot registry (no natural per-key namespace for a document-level operation, unlike CodeList's list_id or Extension's QName) holding an optional SignatureBackend(verify, sign) pair, plus verify_signature()/sign_document() functions.

6. Initially wrote sign_document() to raise ValueError when no backend is registered, then reconsidered for consistency with this package's established 'registries never raise, always return a tri-state/optional result' precedent (CodeListRegistry.get() returns None; decode_extension() returns adapter_known=False) -- revised sign_document() to return None instead, matching verify_signature()'s own not-registered-is-safe shape.

7. Probed interactively before writing any test: no-backend verify (backend_registered=False, verified=None), no-backend sign (None), registered backend verify (real True result), registered backend sign (real document returned by identity) -- all 4 cases behaved correctly on the first attempt after the raise-to-None revision.

All passed on the first attempt.

11. Ran ruff (clean), mypy on the new module (clean), the full ubl suite (983 passed, was 972, +11), and the full 6-format regression (3477 passed, was 3466, +11; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.
